features: Mini wireless NVR with built-in Wi-Fi router; network connection supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi only
Only compatible with Hiseeu wireless cameras; does not support ONVIF
With 5MP cameras, playback is limited to 2 cameras at the same time
Recording modes: timed, motion detection; SD card, hard disk and cloud storage recording
Playback: smart, regular, event; backup via USB and during app playback
notes: Spec table gives the input as 10 channels at 5MP and key features state a 5MP maximum, while the recording resolution list includes 8MP. Maximum camera resolution left out.
Power consumption stated as 5 W or less without hard disk.
